# Fire resistance barley wine

Type: Mead | Internal ID: BarleyWine | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Barley wine base: Fire resistance x1 | Duration: 10m | Cooldown: 10m | Other Effect(s): Resistance vs. Fire

# Introduction

Fire resistance barley wine is a Plains-tier consumable item fermented from Barley wine base: Fire resistance.

## Recipe

Barley wine base: Fire resistance is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Barley
• 10 Cloudberries
Six Fire resistance barley wines are produced by fermenting the wine base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Consuming it grants Resistant vs. Fire for 600s (10 minutes), reducing fire damage taken (see resistance for details).

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
